newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down in lower trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed 0.62 percent down on Thursday in lower trade in bank shares, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 601.65 from 603.84 on Tuesday.
Trade volume was 1.696 million dinars against 2.144 million dinars.

BIAT bank was down 1.91 dinar to 61.8 dinars. Amen Bank eased 1.8 dinar to 58.12 dinars. Banque de l'Habitat was down 1.05 dinar to 33.95 dinars. BNDT bank lost 0.89 dinar to 28.68 dinars. ($=0.97 dinar)
